recognition_trigger: When runs are defined by consecutive values rather than adjacent input positions, index adjacency is irrelevant.
corrected_rule: Put unique values in a set and start expanding from n only when n - 1 is absent.
why_failed: A sliding window follows adjacent positions in the original collection, so it can miss consecutive values that appear at separated indices.
application: Deduplicate into a set, identify every run start by the absence of n - 1, advance through n + 1 while present, and track the maximum run length in expected O(n) time and O(n) space.
